title: 第19章 再度登门第20章 药债
slug: 从一证永证开始成神第432章
content_zh:
;;
哑巷的雾，到了清晨也没散。
雾气从地缝里往上冒，贴着墙根往上爬，把整条三巷压得低低的，喘口气都费劲。
屋里更暗。
叶霄醒来后，背脊僵得发麻，仿佛整夜都贴着冷硬的石面；他稍一转头，颈骨便“咔”地轻响了一声。
昨晚他本想靠着墙调息，把呼吸调稳，再继续练拳，却因身体撑不住，半途就睡死过去。
胸口那块空仍在，补不回来。
但前几日那股向外扩的危险劲头，倒是收住了些，被他硬压在还能承受的边界里。
“哥？”
一道清脆的声音轻轻响起。
小雪抱着一个洗得发白的布偶坐在床边，头发乱乱的，眼睛却亮。
那是叶霄捡回来的布偶，也是她最宝贝的东西。
“你怎么又睡在地上？地上很凉的。”
小雪小心翼翼地说。
叶霄活动了下发麻的手臂：“没事。”
他目光扫过屋子。
角落那口小灶早熄了，锅里扣着昨夜剩下的稀粥，粥面结着薄薄一层皮。
小雪顺着他的视线一看，猛地想起什么，一下从床上蹦下来，把布偶放好。
“我去把粥热一热！很快！”
她踮着脚生火，动作放得极轻，生怕吵到娘。

穷巷里的孩子早当家。
床上的母亲压着声音咳了一阵，咳得很克制，生怕惊着他们。
叶霄听出她醒了，走过去：“娘，你是不是根本没买自己的药？”
母亲眼神躲开：“老毛病了，又治不好，不如省下来。”
“娘，钱的事你别管。”
叶霄声音里压着无奈：“我在北炉赚的钱花得起。等我成了武馆内门学员，赚的只会更多。”
“吃的也要买好一点。不只给你们养身子，也能让我练武更稳，不能再省。”
母亲本想再劝，听到“练武”两个字，话又咽了回去，只轻轻点头。
她不清楚叶霄练到哪一步，但她知道，这是全家唯一的路。
小灶那边传来粥轻微沸腾的声音，屋里终于有了一点暖意。
“哥，粥好了。”
小雪端着碗过来，脚步很稳，小心却不慌。
她把碗递到他面前，却没立刻松手。
她抬头看他，眼里有认真，也有怕：
“哥……你脸色好白。”
叶霄看见她指尖冰凉，低声道：“我没事。”
小雪吸了一口气，把话说完整：
“那……你等一下再出去，好不好？先多吃几碗粥。娘说过，不吃早饭会没力气的。”
这是母亲常说的，她记得很牢。
叶霄沉默了一瞬，接过碗。

小雪这才松了口气，又把布偶抱紧，确认哥哥不会忽然倒下后才安静下来。
叶霄抬手揉了揉她乱糟糟的头发，动作很轻。
他几口吃完第一碗，又连吃几碗：“我待会去把药买回来。”
母亲抬起头，眼神虚弱：“不急……你先去武馆，明天不是有考核？”
一听考核，小雪眼睛立刻亮了：“就是那种考上了，走在街上别人都会让路的？”

The fog in Mute Alley did not lift even in the early morning.
The mist came up from the cracks in the ground and climbed up against the walls, weighing down the entire three alleys, making it difficult to breathe.
The room is darker.
After Ye Xiao woke up, his back was numb and stiff, as if he had been pressed against the cold stone surface all night; when he turned his head slightly, his neck bones made a soft "click" sound.
Last night, he wanted to lean against the wall to regulate his breathing, steady his breathing, and then continue practicing boxing, but because his body couldn't hold on, he fell asleep halfway.
The void in my chest is still there and cannot be filled back.
But the dangerous momentum that had spread outward in the past few days had been restrained, and he had suppressed it within the limits of what could be tolerated.
"Brother?"
A crisp voice sounded softly.
Xiaoxue sat beside the bed holding a white washed doll, with messy hair and bright eyes.
That was the stuffed doll that Ye Xiao picked up, and it was also her most precious thing.
"Why are you sleeping on the ground again? The ground is very cold."
Xiaoxue said cautiously.
Ye Xiao moved his numb arms: "It's okay."
He glanced around the room.
The small stove in the corner had long been turned off, and the pot was filled with the leftover gruel from last night. The porridge was covered with a thin layer of skin.
Xiaoxue followed his line of sight and suddenly remembered something. She jumped out of bed and put the dolls away.
"I'll heat up the porridge! Soon!"
She stood on tiptoes to light the fire, moving very gently for fear of disturbing her mother.
The children in the back alleys have already become masters.
The mother on the bed coughed under her breath for a while, coughing very restrainedly, for fear of shocking them.
Ye Xiao heard that she was awake and walked over: "Mom, did you not buy your own medicine at all?"
Mother's eyes averted: "It's an old problem and it can't be cured, so why not save it."
"Mom, don't worry about money."
Ye Xiao's voice was filled with helplessness: "I can afford to spend the money I earn in Beiluo. When I become a student in the martial arts school, I will earn even more."
"You also need to buy better food. Not only will it keep you healthy, it will also make my martial arts training more stable. I can't save any more."
My mother wanted to persuade her again, but when she heard the word "practice martial arts", she swallowed her words and just nodded lightly.
She didn't know how far Ye Xiao had reached, but she knew that this was the only way for the whole family.
There was the sound of porridge boiling slightly from the small stove, and there was finally a little warmth in the room.
"Brother, the porridge is ready."
Xiaoxue came over with a bowl, her steps were steady, careful but not panicky.
She handed the bowl to him but didn't let go immediately.
She looked up at him, with seriousness and fear in her eyes:
"Brother...you look so pale."
Ye Xiao saw her fingertips were cold and whispered, "I'm fine."
Xiaoxue took a breath and finished her sentence:
"Then...you can go out later, okay? Eat a few more bowls of porridge first. Mom said you will lose energy if you don't eat breakfast."
This is what my mother often said, and she remembers it very well.
Ye Xiao was silent for a moment and took the bowl.
Xiaoxue breathed a sigh of relief, hugged the puppet tightly again, and calmed down after making sure that her brother would not fall down suddenly.
Ye Xiao raised his hand and rubbed her messy hair very gently.
He finished the first bowl in a few mouthfuls, and then several more bowls in succession: "I'll buy the medicine later."
Mother raised her head with weak eyes: "No hurry...you go to the martial arts gym first, isn't there a test tomorrow?"
Upon hearing about the assessment, Xiaoxue's eyes immediately lit up: "Is it the kind of thing where if you pass the exam, everyone will give way to you when walking on the street?"
